name: remvu
description: Portable project memory and evidence-backed handoffs for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Maintain private project memory and create a single REMVU.md handoff with intent, decisions, code state and evidence. Includes Claude Code and Codex lifecycle adapters and the legacy evidence exporter. Requires local Python 3.10+; excludes hidden reasoning. See the repository compatibility report for tested clients.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Remvu to update this project's memory and prepare a verified handoff.
